defmodule UploadService.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  import Plug.Conn

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  # Upload endpoint for processing user files
  post "/api/v1/uploads" do
    conn = fetch_query_params(conn)
    {:ok, body, conn} = read_body(conn)
    
    with {:ok, claims} <- UploadService.Auth.verify_token(conn),
         {:ok, upload_meta} <- Jason.decode(body),
         :ok <- UploadService.Policy.authorize(claims, upload_meta) do
      {:ok, result} <- UploadService.Processor.handle_upload(claims, upload_meta)
      conn
      |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
      |> send_resp(201, Jason.encode!(%{status: "created", id: result.id}))
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "forbidden"}))
      {:error, :invalid_token} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, Jason.encode!(%{error: "unauthorized"}))
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: to_string(reason)}))
    end
  end

  # Admin endpoint to manage upload quotas
  put "/api/v1/admin/quotas/:user_id" do
    conn = fetch_query_params(conn)
    {:ok, body, conn} = read_body(conn)
    
    with {:ok, claims} <- UploadService.Auth.verify_token(conn),
         {:ok, quota_params} <- Jason.decode(body),
         :ok <- UploadService.Policy.authorize_admin(claims) do
      UploadService.Quotas.update(conn.params["user_id"], quota_params)
      send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "updated"}))
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized} ->
        send_resp(conn, 403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "forbidden"}))
      _ ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: "bad request"}))
    end
  end
end

defmodule UploadService.Auth do
  @secret Application.compile_env(:upload_service, :jwt_secret, "supersecret")

  def verify_token(conn) do
    with ["Bearer " <> token] <- get_req_header(conn, "authorization"),
         {:ok, claims} <- decode_and_verify(token) do
      {:ok, claims}
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_token}
    end
  end

  defp decode_and_verify(token) do
    case JOSE.JWT.verify_strict(JOSE.JWK.from_oct(@secret), ["HS256"], token) do
      {true, %JOSE.JWT{fields: claims}, _} -> {:ok, claims}
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_token}
    end
  end
end

defmodule UploadService.Policy do
  @moduledoc """
  Authorization policy engine. Checks role-based access for upload operations.
  Roles: "admin", "editor", "viewer"
  """

  @upload_roles ["admin", "editor"]

  def authorize(claims, upload_meta) do
    user_role = get_effective_role(claims, upload_meta)
    if user_role in @upload_roles do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  def authorize_admin(claims) do
    if claims["role"] == "admin" do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  # Determines effective role considering delegation tokens.
  # A user can delegate their upload capability to another user
  # by including a "delegated_by" field in the upload metadata.
  # The effective role is the HIGHER of the two roles when delegation is present.
  defp get_effective_role(claims, upload_meta) do
    base_role = claims["role"] || "viewer"
    
    case Map.get(upload_meta, "delegated_by") do
      nil -> base_role
      delegator_id -> resolve_delegation(delegator_id, base_role)
    end
  end

  defp resolve_delegation(delegator_id, requester_role) do
    # Look up the delegator's role from the delegation registry
    case UploadService.DelegationRegistry.get_delegator_role(delegator_id) do
      {:ok, delegator_role} -> highest_role(delegator_role, requester_role)
      {:error, _} -> requester_role
    end
  end

  defp highest_role(role_a, role_b) do
    role_priority = %{"admin" => 3, "editor" => 2, "viewer" => 1}
    pa = Map.get(role_priority, role_a, 0)
    pb = Map.get(role_priority, role_b, 0)
    if pa >= pb, do: role_a, else: role_b
  end
end

defmodule UploadService.DelegationRegistry do
  use Agent

  def start_link(_opts) do
    Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def register_delegation(delegator_id, delegator_role, delegatee_id) do
    Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn state ->
      Map.put(state, delegator_id, %{role: delegator_role, delegatee: delegatee_id})
    end)
  end

  def get_delegator_role(delegator_id) do
    case Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn state -> Map.get(state, delegator_id) end) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      %{role: role} -> {:ok, role}
    end
  end
end

defmodule UploadService.Processor do
  def handle_upload(claims, upload_meta) do
    file_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
    owner_id = claims["sub"]
    
    # Process and store the upload
    {:ok, %{id: file_id, owner: owner_id, type: upload_meta["content_type"]}}
  end
end
